title: Derived restriction of the open adjunction unit is invertible
statement: For a scheme X [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], open U, chosen derived module categories on X and its over-site [def-pc-derived-category], and any adjunction from exact derived restriction L to R, the morphism L(unit(K)) is an isomorphism for every K in D(O_X). No quasi-coherence or support hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open (08BS) and lemma-restrict-direct-image-open (08FE); exact open extension and restriction

proof.text: Use the concrete exact extension by zero G and its adjunction to over-site restriction F. Localize the termwise complex adjunction at quasi-isomorphisms to get G_D left adjoint to F_D.

Derive the extension/restriction composition isomorphism to identify G_D followed by F_D with the identity. Hence G_D is fully faithful. Adjoint triple full-faithfulness equivalence implies the supplied R is fully faithful; the adjunction triangle identity then makes F_D(unit(K)) invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_open_unit_restriction_isIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (R : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⊣ R)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map
      (adj.unit.app K))
